evidence.source: Independent read-only verification of the Development project on 13 August 2026 confirms contract 188. The record it replaces still said 185 and was stale by three contracts: contracts 186, 187 and 188 reached Development through fast-lane rollout run 31721168774 from exact main 806e4744c929f5913bb618a0129c4756faa8bb18, which concluded success at 2026-08-13T16:32:11Z, and no record-only follow-up had landed on main. Confirmed by a query that NAMES the expected ledger rows rather than counting them — 20260812080000 cup_group_stage_span, 20260812090000 season_cup_qualification_driver and 20260813100000 ai_lab_multi_model_evidence are each present — beside a total of 188 and the named latest row. A count alone is the shape that went stale for twenty-five minutes against a hosted ledger on 11 August 2026, so it is not the claim relied on here. Contract 188's objects were then confirmed installed rather than merely migrated: ai.team_aliases holds 223 rows, ai.canonical_from_odds_api, ai.repair_provider_identity, ai.reconcile_api_budget and ai.quarantine_identity_defective_predictions all exist, the ai.valid_predictions view exists, and ai.recommendations, ai.prediction_invalidations and ai.provider_identity_repairs all exist with row-level security enabled. The defect contract 188 was rewritten to avoid is measured on the INSTALLED definition rather than the migration text: public.record_ai_odds_snapshot creates no temporary table, re-derives identity through ai.canonical_from_odds_api, and no function in public or predictor_internal retains a temporary-table dependency. public.admin_ai_bet_builder_candidates carries the identity argument types text, text[], timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone, integer. No browser role holds direct DML on any ai relation and no browser role reaches the repair, reconciliation or quarantine authorities. Alias correctness was checked against the real vocabulary rather than against a second authority: every named mapping resolves through ai.canonical_from_odds_api and every canonical target exists in the 46215 retained ai.raw_matches rows, including Raith Rovers to Raith Rvs, which is the pair two authorities previously agreed on and both got wrong. Contract 187's tournament behaviour is unchanged on Development — all 4 tournament Championships resolve a group-stage span of exactly 3, and contract 169's cup_final_group_tables still carries its between 1 and 3 bound. PAID COLLECTION IS DISABLED IN DEVELOPMENT and no paid provider request has ever been made there: ai.api_budget.collection_enabled is false, ai.api_usage holds 0 rows, ai.predictions holds 0 rows and ai.odds_api_events holds 0 rows. Contract 188's identity repair has not been run on Development and has nothing to repair — ai.provider_identity_repairs, ai.prediction_invalidations and ai.recommendations all hold 0 rows, so installing the authority did not call it. This is database state only and claims no application publication.
